hypotheses.name: Support-weighted zigzag utility coupling
hypotheses.method: Computed true zigzag H1 lifetimes on paired source->union<-target kNN complexes across 3 domains x 3 seeds x layers {0,3,7,11}; compared support-threshold weighted excess vs unweighted excess against target-set permutation nulls and tested coupling to iter_0016 diffusion utility deltas.
hypotheses.result_value: 1/3 domains; weighted>unweighted rows 0/36; leave-domain-out R2 weighted=-0.5186 vs unweighted=-1.0049
hypotheses.next_action: Retire this weighted-threshold formulation unless rescued with a materially changed edge-level weighted persistence model.

hypotheses.name: Bifiltration-like cycle-rank enrichment
hypotheses.method: On seed42 across immune/lung/external_lung and source/target-disjoint splits at layers {0,3,7,11}, built kNN graph cycle-rank features over a distance x support threshold grid and compared edge-label AUROC to a distance-only ablation, with support-shuffle nulls within distance strata.
hypotheses.result_value: mean delta AUROC=+0.00566; positive rows 24/24; p<0.05 rows 13/24; domain-split Fisher significant 6/6
hypotheses.next_action: Promote to multi-seed expansion (42/43/44) and test sign stability by domain/split.

hypotheses.name: Cross-model top-k motif overlap enrichment
hypotheses.method: Computed scGPT (layerwise centered-cosine) and Geneformer (embedding centered-cosine) top-k edge sets for k={50,100,200} at layers {7,11}; measured cross-model overlap of FFL+bifan motifs with degree-preserving target-permutation nulls.
hypotheses.result_value: domain Fisher significant 1/3 (immune only); significant rows 4/18 all in immune
hypotheses.next_action: Run one focused immune rescue with expanded motif panel and stricter split-robustness checks before broader cross-model claims.
hypotheses.retirement_reason: cross_model_alignment remains a rescue-only branch; this method is materially changed (motif overlap rather than manifold map transfer).
